entries.title: Prevent OneDrive from being used for file storage
entries.description: Applies DisableFileSyncNGSC so the OneDrive sync client cannot be used. Files already in the cloud stay there; Explorer no longer syncs. This is the supported policy, not an uninstall of OneDriveSetup.exe.
entries.rationale: Hiding the navigation-pane pin leaves OneDrive running. Microsoft's Prevent the usage of OneDrive for file storage policy stops the client without deleting cloud data and reverts by deleting the policy. Full uninstall is not in the command allow-list.

managedBy.groupPolicyPath: Computer Configuration\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\OneDrive\Prevent the usage of OneDrive for file storage

sideEffects: OneDrive does not sync. Known Folder Move, Files On-Demand and the OneDrive Explorer overlay stop. Files already in the cloud are not deleted. Sign out (or reboot) for Explorer to pick this up.

entries.title: Turn off Cross Device Resume
entries.description: Sets IsResumeAllowed=0 so Windows does not offer to resume phone or PC activity on this device via Cross Device Resume.
entries.rationale: Cross Device Resume is a later hand-off surface than the classic CDP 'Continue experiences' policy. This preference turns the Resume offer off without disabling Phone Link wholesale. Absent by default.
sideEffects: The Resume / pick-up-where-you-left-off offer no longer appears. Phone Link itself stays installed unless a separate debloat entry removes it.
